duplicate_policy: Exact rows are merged. Conflicting match_id and player_ref rows fail.

timing_assumptions.collection_time: The page fetch time is collection evidence. It is not historical availability evidence.
timing_assumptions.default_result_availability: The match loader assumes the next venue-local day when no explicit result time exists.
timing_assumptions.lineup: The players are final participants assumed to be known at kickoff for this benchmark.
timing_assumptions.statistics_available_at: Use the matched result availability time. When the CSV omits this column, the model loader uses the same result-availability rule.
